### ToolCallChip()

```ts
function ToolCallChip(__namedParameters): Element;
```

One tool call as a chip. While it runs a quiet fill wipes across and a live
clock counts; when it lands the fill completes and washes away; when it fails
the chip shakes and offers a retry.
